modernizationPaths.description: Replace JSF Facelets and backing beans with a React SPA served separately, while retaining the existing JEE EJB service and DAO layer exposed as JAX-RS REST endpoints. Minimal disruption to proven business logic; existing JPA model, EJB services, and H2/JDBC configuration stay largely intact. React's component model maps naturally to the portal's form pages.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Convert JSF managed beans to JAX-RS resources; replace FacesMessage/navigation outcomes with REST error contracts; migrate session-scoped ParkingPermitBean state to JWT/cookie auth; replicate inline JSF validation with React form validation; add CORS configuration for decoupled deployment.

modernizationPaths.description: Full modernisation: rewrite the backend on Quarkus using CDI, Panache ORM, and RESTEasy Reactive, while the frontend becomes a React SPA. Quarkus offers fast startup, GraalVM native compilation, and a developer-friendly DX. Highest ROI for cloud-native deployments but requires rewriting EJBs as CDI beans and adapting JPA entities for Panache.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Rewrite all EJB Stateless beans to CDI/ApplicationScoped; migrate JPA entities to Panache Active Record or Repository pattern; replace JTA/Liberty DataSource config with Quarkus datasource; implement JWT-based auth to replace HttpSession; restructure Maven build for both SPA and API modules.

modernizationPaths.description: Incremental modernisation pairing Vue.js with the existing JEE backend. Vue's Options API and single-file components map closely to JSF backing bean concepts, easing the conceptual gap for JEE developers. JAX-RS endpoints added to the existing WAR expose the EJB services. Suitable when teams are familiar with JEE and want a gentle frontend transition.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Expose EJB services as JAX-RS endpoints without breaking existing session model; replace JSF navigation outcome pattern with Vue Router; map JSF h:dataTable and PrimeFaces p:dataTable to Vue component equivalents; manage auth state with Pinia store instead of HttpSession; configure separate build pipeline for Vue assets.

modernizationPaths.description: Modernise both layers simultaneously: Vue.js replaces the Facelets views, Quarkus replaces Liberty/EJB. Quarkus's streamlined CDI model and Panache reduce boilerplate compared to EJB. The combination yields a lightweight, reactive stack. Recommended for teams open to a clean-slate approach with modern tooling across both tiers.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Migrate all four EJB DAOs and three EJB services to Quarkus CDI/Panache; replace JTA transactions with Quarkus @Transactional; rewrite session auth as Quarkus OIDC or SmallRye JWT; port Facelets form logic to Vue reactive forms; set up monorepo or multi-module build for co-located development.

modernizationPaths.description: Replace the JSF tier with Angular while keeping the JEE backend. Angular's opinionated structure with services, dependency injection, and TypeScript mirrors EJB patterns, easing adoption for JEE developers. The existing EJBs are surfaced as JAX-RS REST endpoints. Suitable for enterprise teams already familiar with Java-style DI wanting a comparable pattern on the frontend.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Add JAX-RS layer to existing WAR for all portal operations; implement Angular HttpClient-based service layer replacing FacesServlet postbacks; migrate PrimeFaces p:dataTable pagination to Angular Material or PrimeNG; replace JSF FacesMessages with Angular Reactive Forms error handling; configure CORS and CSRF protection for separated deployment.

modernizationPaths.description: Enterprise-grade full-stack modernisation: Angular provides a strongly-typed, opinionated SPA framework, while Quarkus delivers a cloud-native Java backend with native-image support. Both frameworks emphasise strong typing and DI, making the combination coherent for large teams. This path demands the most upfront effort but yields the most modern and maintainable outcome.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Complete rewrite of EJB layer to Quarkus CDI with Panache and RESTEasy; migrate JPA H2 config to Quarkus application.properties datasource; implement Quarkus Security or OIDC replacing HttpSession auth; map all JSF validation rules to Angular Reactive Forms validators; establish CI/CD pipeline for separate Angular build and Quarkus container image.
